title: Good form, strange fortunes
dek: 301 images, four creative worlds: tennis heritage, dream cars, imagined money and future gardens.
body:
A Hoydich Advertising collection directed by Mike Hoydich: 300 Midjourney images across 75 completed four-image sets, plus one standalone OpenAI-generated planet with two moons.

The feature brings together Court Society, Pop Treasury, Dream Garage and Future Botanica, with selected artwork, all four moodboards, a complete source-job index and the original brand palette.

Independent speculative creative studies. Referenced brands are subjects, not commissioning clients or partners. Imagined currency is artwork, not legal tender.

Creative direction: Mike Hoydich. Editorial and curation: Codex.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich creative directions in ChatGPT, 17–18 October 2026; explicit publication directive: “ok publish as a feature on pointcast”. Verified collection ledger: 75 completed Midjourney jobs × four images plus one standalone planet.
